q: At a pitchfork bifurcation (common in symmetric systems), as the parameter passes through the critical value:
opts: One stable equilibrium becomes unstable and two new stable equilibria are born (supercritical) or vice versa (subcritical)
exp: Supercritical pitchfork: single stable equilibrium loses stability and two symmetric stable equilibria are born. Subcritical: two unstable equilibria merge with the main equilibrium, which then loses stability. Occurs in systems with ℤ₂ symmetry (x ↦ −x).
